datasets.name: access_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      :country IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:country, 'All')
    THEN
      'All accessible data shown for your assigned region'
    WHEN
      EXISTS (
        SELECT
          1
        FROM
          maven_catalog.audit.user_country_mapping m
        WHERE
          m.user_email = current_user()
          AND array_contains(:country, m.assigned_country)
      )
    THEN
      CONCAT('✓ Authorized: Showing data for selected countries')
    ELSE
      CONCAT(
        '⚠ Access Denied: You are not assigned to the selected countries. Please select your assigned country.'
      )
  END AS access_status
